violations.text: An employee bag was observed stored on the clean dish rack in contact with clean dishes/utensils. Equipment was moved to be cleaned and sanitized. Equipment must be protected from potential contamination. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
A knife was observed stored underneath the cutting board of the prep unit. Knife relocated. Proper storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
No person in certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Per PIC, another employee will take the food safety course. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2024

Brownies packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 04/03/2024
The 3-bay sink was observed with a leak. Per PIC, establishment has called a plumber to fix leak with 3-bay. New Violation. Correct By: 04/03/2024
